nurse.text: Hello, dear. Sark Sanctuary. We're the only clinic for three miles and the ambulance is a tractor. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit down. There's tea, a scone and the best view of the sunset you'll ever get from a waiting room.
All done. Good as new. Mind the hill on the way out, it's got ideas.
The Ark's in the corner. It came on the boat and says never again, but that's what everybody says.

else.text: Right you are. Don't forget to wave to everybody.
